exposure: Exposure to fermented and unpasteurized milk
Antenatal exposures to pets, livestock, and cigarette smoke
Consumption of fruits and vegetables, fast foods, soft drinks/fruit juices, and fried/microwaved meat
cohort: Toddlers aged 12 to 36 months in urban and rural South Africa
finding: Risk and protective factors for allergic diseases differed between urban and rural settings, with farm animal exposure being protective in rural children and cesarean section being a risk factor for food allergy in urban children.
mod_finding: In urban children, birth by cesarean section was associated with food allergy.
